# Stretch 2.0
A free, open-source, local-only stretch reminder. Version 2.0 focuses on macOS.
Ten illustrated movements, local daily progress, quiet hours, snooze, and a guided player.
Movement cues are short adaptations of NHS, Mayo Clinic, and HSE guidance; no clinical endorsement.
The app does not detect meetings or macOS Focus. Sources open only on user action.
Published releases: https://github.com/praveensankar969/Stretch/releases
Privacy: https://stretchapp.in/privacy.html
